title: Explore the BEST Spots in Downtown Belton TX | A Hidden Gem Between Austin and Waco
description:
Are you considering moving to Belton, Texas? Located just an hour outside of Austin and 45 minutes from Waco, downtown Belton offers a charming mix of history, local businesses, and vibrant community life. If you’re thinking about moving to Belton, Texas, this video will show you everything you need to know about the local businesses, attractions, and lifestyle that make this town an amazing place to call home.

FREE GUIDE:
Relocation Guide → https://bit.ly/3DWFw7V

This video takes you on a tour of the best spots in Belton TX, from the peaceful Creekside Park at Nolan Creek to delicious local restaurants like Water Street Waffle Co and Coronas De Oro. Belton’s small-town charm, combined with modern amenities like Baylor Scott and White medical facilities and the University of Mary Hardin-Baylor, makes it an ideal place for homebuyers looking to enjoy the beauty of Central Texas!

Whether you’re relocating from Austin TX or Waco TX, or just looking for a change of scenery, downtown Belton TX offers the perfect blend of a welcoming community and convenient access to larger cities.
